compiler.integration: Separate example using the evidence-admission compiler pin; existing Policy Studio generator, primary compiler pin, machine gate and portable binaries remain separate.

shared_input.meaning: All possible effects across supported inputs, temporary work and successful or failed paths, taken from a host-owned audited tool/version registry.

rules.readOnlyHint: NOT (mutatesTarget OR mutatesSession OR writesFilesystem OR launchesProcess OR accessesNetwork OR changesUiState OR mayDiscardData OR executesForeignCode OR mutatesDevice)

AnnotationsFromEffects.verification_domain: All 2^10 Boolean assignments, comparing all four fields to the exact pinned pure upstream function and independently authored expectations.

ToolReturnsTargetContent.verification_domain: Finite independently authored Text cases; unknown and near-match names remain true. Text-domain exhaustiveness is not claimed.
ToolReturnsTargetContent.does_not: A false target-content marker does not authorize execution or imply absence of other effects.

EffectBudgetAccepts.ownership: Original Gooo composition; not a REA port.

conditions.admissible: All ten condition fields are true. All flags remain visible even when an earlier condition fails.

EffectBudgetAccepts.verification_domain: Finite independently authored budget expectations, including singleton failures, combinations and first-reason precedence. The complete 2^20 input domain is not claimed.

host_owned_preconditions: Authenticate the machine principal and select an actual execution permission before dispatch. This pure relation contains no per-call human approval condition.

Maintain a complete audited effect registry bound to the exact tool implementation/version and all supported inputs, including failure paths and temporary work. Do not take permission-establishing flags from a caller, model, tool name heuristic or self-description.

Reject missing, unaudited or stale tool/version entries at the host boundary before projecting ToolEffects. The upstream metadata resolver throws for missing audit entries; this port does not implement that resolver.
Strictly decode all required Boolean fields; missing fields, string booleans and extra fields are not implicit false/default effects. Own all EffectBudget values in current policy.

Bind the selected audit, budget, principal, request, operation, current policy and implementation revision at the serialized dispatch boundary. Recheck changing host state before an effect is executed.
Enforce filesystem, process, network, UI and device restrictions with appropriate host controls. A descriptive MCP hint or admissible budget result does not impose a sandbox.
Provide durable idempotency and outcome handling where needed. A true idempotent fact is compatibility metadata, not proof of exactly-once remote execution.

Keep output containing target/provider/process/device text untrusted. The target-content function marks every unknown name as possibly carrying such content; it does not establish tool identity or authenticity.
Check evidence completeness, provenance, request/artifact/policy bindings and freshness separately before automatic dispatch. Historical execution receipts and replay grant no fresh permission.
automation_example: A host-owned API adapter automatically compares a version-bound tool audit with a current machine policy budget. A read-only analysis budget may allow session recording while denying target writes, filesystem writes, foreign code and device mutation. Denied effect categories are reported together; the first failure selects one stable reason. No human approval field is required in this pure decision.

reproducibility.coverage: Preserve every case in order, compare every output field, execute and replay actual generated code per batch, retain exact workspace/source/case/compiler/runtime bindings. Do not trim the corpus to fit one batch.
reproducibility.actual_execution_status: This contract is not execution evidence. Inspect observations.json from an actual helper or CI run.

not_claimed: Full REA runtime or full upstream tool registry translation
Actual tool execution or sandbox enforcement
Integration with the existing machine gate or previously released portable binaries
All-input budget correctness, all-Text content-marker validation or autonomous-system safety
Customer adoption, trials, revenue or endorsement
